notes: song_id_base: 0 = auto (CUSTOM_VOICE_SONG_ID_MAX + 1). IDs must stay below 800 for PlayMusic().
loop: when true (default), the track loops via m4a GOTO (0xB2) after a tied note.
codec: dpcm (default, compressed) or pcm8 (uncompressed fallback).
gain_db: optional per-track loudness boost/cut in dB before peak normalization.
trim_silence: optional; strips leading/trailing near-silence before PCM encode (default false for music).
Long tracks use one PCM WaveData and one m4a TIE/EOT note so playback is uninterrupted.
No audio-frame hook is used; custom music plays through normal PlayMusic() / BGM player 0.
gain_db: default 4 dB if omitted; levels are clamped to avoid 8-bit wrap distortion.
